title: Instruments, Initiating Parties and Holding Limits for Benefit Withholding and Deduction Orders
content:
Of the six kinds of Benefit Withholding and Deduction Orders, two exist only by the claimant's own election and four are created by the instruction of an outside agency. For every kind, the party whose instruction creates the holding, the instrument and channel by which it is received, what the instrument must show, and how many holdings of the kind a claimant may carry are fixed as follows.

## A. Origin and instrument

| Kind | Exists only by the claimant's own election | Party whose instruction creates it | Instrument / certificate | Channel by which it is received |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Voluntary Federal Income Tax Withholding | Yes | The claimant | IRS Form W-4V (withholding certificate) | Online, or on Form W-4V |
| Voluntary State Income Tax Withholding | Yes | The claimant | Lakeland Form UI-W4 (withholding certificate) | Online, or on the state withholding form |
| Child Support Withholding — Current Support Order | No | The IV-D agency | Income withholding order | IV-D income withholding order |
| Child Support Withholding — Arrears-Only Order | No | The IV-D agency | Income withholding order, arrears only | IV-D income withholding order |
| SNAP Overissuance Recovery — Household or Agency Error | No | The SNAP agency | SNAP claim for an inadvertent household or agency error | SNAP agency certification |
| SNAP Overissuance Recovery — Intentional Program Violation | No | The SNAP agency | SNAP claim for an intentional program violation | SNAP agency certification |

The four agency kinds have no withholding certificate ("not applicable"); the certificate exists only for the two voluntary kinds.

## B. What the instrument must show

| Kind | IV-D case number or SNAP claim number required on the order | Total amount to be recovered (certified amount) required on the order |
|---|---|---|
| Voluntary Federal Income Tax Withholding | No | No |
| Voluntary State Income Tax Withholding | No | No |
| Child Support Withholding — Current Support Order | Yes — IV-D case number | No |
| Child Support Withholding — Arrears-Only Order | Yes — IV-D case number | Yes |
| SNAP Overissuance Recovery — Household or Agency Error | Yes — SNAP claim number | Yes |
| SNAP Overissuance Recovery — Intentional Program Violation | Yes — SNAP claim number | Yes |

## C. Holding limits and renewal

| Kind | Holdings of the kind a claimant may have requested or active at once | Second election of the same kind may stand on the same claim | Renewal required each benefit year |
|---|---|---|---|
| Voluntary Federal Income Tax Withholding | 1 | No | No |
| Voluntary State Income Tax Withholding | 1 | No | No |
| Child Support Withholding — Current Support Order | 3 | No | No |
| Child Support Withholding — Arrears-Only Order | 3 | No | No |
| SNAP Overissuance Recovery — Household or Agency Error | 1 | No | No |
| SNAP Overissuance Recovery — Intentional Program Violation | 1 | No | No |

## Points of reading

- The two child support kinds are separate kinds: a claimant may carry up to 3 Current Support Orders and, separately, up to 3 Arrears-Only Orders.
- The two SNAP Overissuance Recovery kinds are likewise separate kinds, each limited to 1.
- No kind of Benefit Withholding and Deduction Orders has to be renewed each benefit year.
- An arrears-only child support order and both SNAP kinds name a total amount to be recovered; a current support order does not.
